Isolating the seventh-degree term, we find

$$
\begin{aligned}(x+5)^{7}-1 & \ge 8 \\ (x+5)^{7} & \ge 9.\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we take the seventh root of both sides and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[7]{(x+5)^{7}} & \ge \sqrt[7]{9} \\ x+5 & \ge \sqrt[7]{9} \\ x & \ge \sqrt[7]{9}-5.\end{aligned}
$$
